name: Acolyte Protection Agency
Text: Can not be played by the APA, Bradshaw and/or Faarooq. Choose one: Your opponent can not play maneuvers on his next 2 turns, or all your maneuvers are +2D for this turn and your next turn.

name: Airplane Spin
Text: When successfully played, you may discard up to 3 cards from your hand, your opponent must discard the same amount.

name: American Bad Ass
Text: End your turn. All the F Values of your opponent's cards are doubled until the end of his second full turn from now. (Example: Punch F: 0 is F: 0, but Knee to the Gut F: 1 is F: 2) If played by the Undertaker, you may draw 1 card.

name: Ass Drop
Text: Can only be played after an 8D or greater maneuver.

name: Attitude Adjustment
Text: If your Fortitude Rating is equal to or less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating you may reverse any Grapple or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, the first card played on your next turn is - #F, where # = F of the maneuver being reversed.

name: B.A. Billy Gunn
Text: Once a turn, reveal your hand to your opponent(s). If you have no maneuvers, reveal cards from your Arsenal to all players, one at a time, until you reveal a maneuver. Put the first maneuver revealed in your hand; all other cards revealed are put back in your Arsenal and shuffled.

name: B.A.'s Military Press Slam
Text: When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Back That Ass Up
Text: Must be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. When successfully played, search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the card titled Stink Face, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Stephanie McMahon
Text: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is equal to his Superstar Value.

name: Backhand Slap
Text: When successfully played, choose one: draw 1 card, or you may look at your opponent's hand.

name: Bait Opponent
Text: Your next maneuver this turn is -6F and your opponent's reversal to it is +6F.

name: Baseball Slide
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a Strike maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip, or after the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring or Giant Swing. If reversed from your opponent's hand, and if the first card played on his next turn is a maneuver, your reversals to that maneuver are at +5F. As a reversal, may only reverse the card titled Roll Out of the Ring. End your opponent's turn.

name: Big Stupid Grin
Text: Reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Borrring ... Borrring ...!!!
Text: As an action, you may discard this card to draw 1 card. As a reversal, if played from your hand, and your opponent has 5 or more ACTION cards that are not Set-up cards in his Ring Area, reverse any ACTION card that is not a Set-up card. It is unsuccessful, goes to his Ringside pile, has no effect and ends his turn.

name: Bronco Buster
Text: You must play the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle before playing this card. When successfully played, opponent must discard 3 cards.

name: Call to the Crowd
Text: Opponent must discard 1 card for every HEEL card he has in his Ring area. All your maneuvers are +1D for the rest of the turn.

name: Chris Benoit
Text: The first maneuver you play each turn is +1D, the second is +2D, the third is +3D, and so forth.

name: Chyna
Text: You can reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn by discarding a maneuver of the same type from your hand to your Ringside pile. Chyna's opponent can not play the cards titled: Chyna Interferes or Puppies! Puppies!

name: Chyna's Patented Low Blow
Text: May reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played against any male Superstar, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Chyna's Pedigree
Text: As an action, you may discard this card and draw up to 2 cards. Doing this will not cause any damage to opponent, and the F Value for this ACTION is F: 0.

name: Claw
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand. When successfully played, search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, put it into his Ringside pile, and your opponent shuffles his Arsenal.

name: Commission-er Rules!
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. If you find any Reversal cards you may choose 1 and your opponent must discard the card chosen.

name: Crippler Crossface
Text: As a maneuver, you may play the card titled Maintain Hold after this card as if it were a Submission maneuver. As a reversal, you may reverse any Strike or Grapple maneuver but you must first discard 1 card.

name: Defensive Cover
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent's maneuvers are -2D until you successfully play a maneuver card. Then disregard the text of this card. The damage modifier of this card is not cumulative with other cards titled Defensive Cover.

name: Defensive Posture
Text: When successfully played, choose Strike, Grapple, Submission, or High Risk. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse the chosen type of maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Dem Damn Dudleyz!
Text: Search your Arsenal for a FOREIGN OBJECT card, and put it in your hand. Then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Do You Like Pie?
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 3 cards and reveal them to your opponent. He chooses 1 card. Put that card into your hand, and the rest into your Ringside pile. This card can not be reversed if played by The Rock.

name: Doggy Pump Handle Slam
Text: When successfully played, opponent must discard 2 cards.

name: Doing the Job
Text: End your turn. Skip your next turn. When your opponent completes his second turn he must then skip his next 2 turns.

name: Double Axe Handle
Text: Can only be played after a 5D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, your opponent's reversal to it is +6F.

name: Double Clothesline
Text: When successfully played, a single 'inactive' tag team partner must discard 1 card. If that partner chooses he may declare to 'tag' in as the 'active' partner at the resolution of this card's damage.

name: Double Underhook Suplex
Text: If played by Tazz, this maneuver is - 1F.

name: Drive, Rikishi, Drive!
Text: Draw 6 cards and end your turn.

name: Drop Toe Hold
Text: When successfully played, you may take 1 card in your opponent's Ring area and put it into his Ringside pile.

name: Eddie Guerrero
Text: The first High Risk maneuver you play each turn cannot be reversed.

name: Elbow Drop
Text: Can only be played after a 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Enter the Stratus-phere
Text: Your opponent overturns 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, you may discard 1 card and then he overturns 2 cards.

name: European Uppercut
Text: When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Eye Rake
Text: As a maneuver, if your next card played this turn is a Strike or Grapple maneuver, it cannot be reversed. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If the first card you play on your next turn is a Strike or Grapple maneuver, it cannot be reversed.

name: Fall-Away Slam
Text: As a maneuver, the card titled Jockeying for Position must be played before playing this card. As a reversal, may only reverse the card titled Cross Body Block or a maneuver played after the card titled From the Top Rope. End your opponent's turn.

name: Falling Fist
Text: Can only be played after a 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, reveal your hand to your opponent.

name: Fame-Ass-er
Text: Reverse any High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, may reverse any High Risk maneuver, or a Strike maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip. End your opponent's turn.

name: Foot Stomp
Text: Can only be played after a 4D or greater maneuver.

name: From the Top Rope
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Strike or Grapple maneuver. Search your Arsenal for 1 High Risk maneuver, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If your next card played this turn is a High Risk maneuver, you can ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text, it is +3D and +1 Stun Value.

name: Front Face Lock
Text: If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +1D.

name: Full Nelson Slam
Text: When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Elbow Drop and put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: German Suplex
Text: When successfully played, overturn 1 card.

name: Get Hardcore
Text: When this card is in your Ring area all maneuvers played by all players are +3D.

name: Get Your GED
Text: Can only be played if the card titled Study for Your GED is in your Ring area. Shuffle up to 15 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, draw 3 cards, and end your turn.

name: Giant Swing
Text: When successfully played, discard 2 cards. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver, your opponent's reversal to it is +20F.

name: Go for the Cheap Pop!
Text: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Guerrero Frog Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver or if this is the first card played of your turn and you reversed a High Risk maneuver to end your opponent's last turn.

name: Hair Pull
Text: When successfully played, you may look at your opponent's hand.

name: Handspring Elbow
Text: May not be reversed. You must play the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle before playing this card. You may draw up to 3 cards

name: Hardyz' Ambush
Text: Take any High Risk maneuver card from your Ringside pile and put it in your hand. Your opponent's reversal to the next High Risk maneuver card you play this turn is +10F.

name: Head Vise
Text: Can only be played after a 3D or greater maneuver.

name: Head-and-Arms Tazzplex
Text: As a reversal, reverse any High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Hebner Calls It
Text: Reverse any Run-in Action, Heel Action, or Foreign Object card played from your opponent's hand and end his turn.

name: Here Kitty, Kitty!
Text: Search your Arsenal for any 1 card and put it into your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. Without showing him, display your hand to your opponent and have him randomly pick 1 card for you to discard.

name: Ho Train!
Text: All players must shuffle the cards in their hand into their Arsenal. Then all players must draw the same number of cards they shuffled into their Arsenal.

name: Huge Bump Out of the Ring
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple or the card titled Irish Whip and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, overturn the appropriate damage regardless of the appearance of any Reversals. Opponent's Strike, Grapple or Irish Whip card stays in his Ring area. After you're done overturning, you may search for any 2 cards in your Arsenal and place them in your hand, shuffle your Arsenal and your opponent's turn ends.

name: I'd Rather Be In Chyna!
Text: Opponent may not play any maneuvers during his next 3 turns.

name: I'm an Ass Man
Text: Choose one: Look through your Arsenal and put 1 card in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal; OR look at your opponent's hand and put 2 cards into his Ringside pile.

name: I've Got Two Words For Ya ...
Logos: Triple H, Road Dogg, X-Pac, Billy Gunn, Shawn Michaels
Text: All players discard their hands or all players put all cards in their Ring area into their Ringside pile. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: In This Very Ring
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, at the start of your opponent's turn, before his draw segment, he must place 1 ACTION card of his choice, if he has one, from his Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Inferno Match
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, whenever a card is successfully played to any player's Ring area, whomever's Ring area the card is going into takes the top card from his Arsenal and puts it into his Ringside pile. (This occurs after all other card effects.) If played by Kane, you may draw 1 card.

name: Integrity
Text: If you have the cards titled Intensity and Intelligence in your Ring area, shuffle up to 7 Face or Heel cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, you may draw 1 additional card during your Draw Segment.

name: Intelligence
Text: If you have the cards titled Intensity and Integrity in your Ring area, shuffle up to 7 Face or Heel cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent plays with his hand revealed.

name: Intensity
Text: If you have the cards titled Integrity and Intelligence in your Ring area, shuffle up to 7 Face or Heel cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your maneuvers are +3D.

name: It's True, It's True!
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, your opponent discards the chosen card, and put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: J.R. Style Slobber-knocker
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, your opponent cannot play actions, unless they are set-ups or run-ins.

name: Jackhammer
Text: When successfully played, opponent must place 1 card in his hand back on top of his Arsenal.

name: Japanese Arm Drag
Text: When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Japanese Arm Drag and put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Jaw Jammer
Text: When successfully played, opponent must place 1 card in his hand back on top of his Arsenal.

name: Juke 'N' Jive
Text: May not be reversed. Put the top 2 cards of your Arsenal into your Ringside pile and your opponent(s) must put the top 8 cards of his Arsenal into his Ringside pile.

name: Just Bring It!
Text: Reverse any Action card if it is not the first Action card played this turn and end your opponent's turn. He reveals his hand and discards all Action cards.

name: Kamikaze Headbutt
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. Cannot be reversed. When successfully played, overturn 2 cards.

name: Kick Out!
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, you may choose to put it into your Ringside pile at the conclusion of overturning an opponent's entire maneuver damage. (This is not considered a reversal.) End your opponent's turn.

name: Kickin' The Shizt-nit Doggy Style
Text: Can reverse any Strike, Grapple, Submission or High Risk maneuver that does 9D or less. Ends your opponent's turn. # = D of maneuver card being reversed. Read as 0 when in your Ring area.

name: Knee Breaker
Text: When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Figure Four Leg Lock and put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. If Figure Four Leg Lock is the next card you play this turn, it is -8F.

name: Knee Lift
Text: As a maneuver, if the next card you play this turn is titled Clothesline, it can not be reversed. As a reversal, may only reverse the card titled Back Body Drop. End your opponent's turn.

name: Knee Smash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, overturn 1 card.

name: Kurt Angle
Text: You can pack both Face and Heel cards.

name: Latino Heeeeeeeat!
Text: Cannot be reversed if the card titled Get Your GED is in your Ring area. Search your Arsenal for up to 3 Maneuver cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Leaping Spin Kick
Text: Reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a 5D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, end your turn.

name: Let's Make Some Noise ...
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, whenever you must discard a card from your hand; you must discard, but you may then draw 1 card for each card discarded.

name: Lift a Boot
Text: May only reverse a High Risk maneuver if played from your hand. End your opponent's turn.

name: Masked Vengeance
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 10 cards, randomly discard 5 of them, and put the rest in your hand.

name: McMahon-Helmsley Era
Text: Playable only if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Draw 2 cards. After you do this, if your opponent has more cards in his hand than you, draw 1 more card.

name: Missile Dropkick
Text: The card titled From the Top Rope must be played before playing this card. Add +2D for every card titled Drop Kick in your Ring area.

name: Monkey Flip
Text: The card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle must be played before playing this card. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card and opponent must discard 2 cards. If reversed from your opponent's hand, you must discard 1 card.

name: Moongoose In the House
Text: Look at the top 5 cards of your Arsenal. Put 1 of the 5 into your hand, and then put the other 4 on the bottom of your Arsenal in any order. If played by Chris Jericho this card can not be reversed.

name: Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a 6D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, you may take 1 card from your Ringside pile and put it into your hand. End your turn. During your opponent's next turn, he can not play any maneuver cards.

name: Northern Lights Suplex
Text: As a maneuver, when successfully played, you may put up to 2 maneuver cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, then shuffle your Arsenal. If played by Tazz, you may instead search your Arsenal for any card with the word 'plex'in it, put that card in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, may only reverse the maneuver titled Piledriver. End your opponent's turn.

name: Northern Lights Tazzplex
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Olympic Slam
Text: This card is -5F if this is your first card played of the turn and you reversed a maneuver to end your opponent's last turn.

name: Patented Austin Kick to the Gut
Text: This card is -3F and +4D when the card titled The Bionic Redneck is in your Ring area. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card and your next maneuver played this turn is -6F.

name: Patented Rock Footstomp
Text: When successfully played, draw 1 card or shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Playing With Fire
Text: Put the top card of your Arsenal in your Ringside Pile. Put any ACTION card in your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: Predictable Opponent
Text: If there are 5 or more maneuvers cards in your opponent's Ring area that are the same type of maneuver (All Strike, Grapple, Submission, High Risk, etc.) you may search your opponent's Arsenal. Remove up to 5 maneuvers of the same type, that your opponent has in his Ring area; and put them in his Ringside pile. Shuffle his Arsenal.

name: Quick Count Ref
Text: Can only be played after an 8D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, you win the game via a Pin Victory condition.

name: Rabid Wolverine
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your turn ends, you may discard 1 card and continue your turn.

name: Reeking of Awesomeness
Text: All opponents must discard 1 card, and all opponents' reversals are +15F to your next maneuver this turn. If played by Edge and/or Christian this card can not be reversed.

name: Ref KO'd!
Text: Can only be played after an opponent plays the card titled Step Aside, Escape Move, or That's Gonna Cost You! from his hand. Your maneuver does no damage, your opponent deals no damage; and your turn does not end. You may draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring area, the card titled Disqualification reads as blank text if played from an opponent's hand.

name: Rest In Peace
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 6 cards, put them into your hand, and put your Arsenal into your Ringside pile.

name: Rikishi
Text: Once during your turn, you may discard 2 cards to your Ringside pile and then search your Arsenal for any 1 maneuver card. Place the chosen card in your hand and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Rikishi Driver
Text: When successfully played, search your Ringside pile and Arsenal for the card titled Ass Drop, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Road Dogg
Text: If your Fortitude Rating is equal to or greater than your opponent's, once during your turn, you may discard 1 card, and opponent must take the top 3 cards from his Arsenal and put them into his Ringside pile. This can not be reversed and is not considered damage.

name: Roll Out of the Way
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw 1 card. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Series of Suplexes
Text: When successfully played, if this card is not reversed from your opponent's Arsenal, you may discard 1 card and then apply the damage and effects of this card and it can be reversed as usual. This can be repeated.

name: Shooting Star Press
Text: The card titled From the Top Rope must be played before playing this card. If reversed from your opponent's hand, take the top 2 cards of your Arsenal and put them into your Ringside pile.

name: Shoulder Breaker
Text: When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Arm Bar and put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. If Arm Bar is the next card you play this turn it is +2D.

name: Shove Off the Top Rope
Text: As an action, you may discard this card to draw 1 card. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Superplex and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, may reverse the card titled From the Top Rope. Opponent must take the top 3 cards from his Arsenal and put them into his Ringside pile. End your opponent's turn and if the first card played on your turn is a maneuver it is +3D.

name: Sidewalk Slam
Text: As a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for a High Risk maneuver, put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, may only reverse the card titled Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. End your opponent's turn.

name: Small Package
Text: As a maneuver, when successfully played, search your Arsenal for the card titled Small Package, put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. If on the same turn, you play three Small Package cards in a row, not reversed, you win the game via a Pin Victory condition. As a reversal, may only reverse the maneuvers titled DDT, Body Slam or Back Body Drop. You may search your Arsenal for the card titled Small Package, put it into your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. If the first two cards you play on your next turn are Small Package in a row, and not reversed, you win the game via a Pin Victory condition.

name: Snap Senton Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver or if this is the first card played of your turn and you reversed a High Risk maneuver to end your opponent's last turn.

name: Splash
Text: Can only be played after a 5D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, discard 1 card of your choice from your hand and your opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Springboard Drop Kick
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Roll Out of the Ring and end your opponent's turn.

name: Stare Down Opponent
Text: Playable only if your opponent has at least one card in his hand. You and opponent must each select a card from your hand and place it face down, then reveal your cards. If your card has a lower F Value, then you may play it, regardless if you have the Fortitude Rating, and it may not be reversed. If your opponent's card has a lower F Value, then your turn ends. On your opponent's turn, he may play the card he revealed as his first card, regardless if he has the Fortitude Rating, and it may not be reversed. If both cards revealed have the same F Value, nothing occurs.

name: STF
Text: Add +1D for every card in your Ring area with the word(s) 'suplex'or 'neck breaker'in the title. If played by Chris Benoit, opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Stink Face
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, your opponent discards his hand.

name: Study for Your GED
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 6 cards, randomly shuffle 3 of them into your Arsenal, and put the rest into your hand.

name: Stump Puller
Text: Can only be played after a 5D or greater maneuver. The card titled Maintain Hold can not be played after this card.

name: Suicide Plancha
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a Strike maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip, or after the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring or Giant Swing. If reversed from your opponent's hand, take the top 4 cards of your Arsenal and put them into your Ringside pile. As a reversal, may only reverse the card titled Roll Out of the Ring.

name: Superplex
Text: Can only be reversed by cards that specifically reverse the card titled Superplex. As a maneuver, must be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. As a reversal, may reverse any High Risk maneuver played after the card titled From the Top Rope and end your opponent's turn.

name: Surfboard
Text: Add +1D for every card titled Arm Bar, Back Breaker or Shoulder Breaker in your Ring area.

name: Surprise Hit
Text: May only be played against an 'inactive'opponent. That opponent may attempt to reverse the maneuver as usual but at +4F.

name: Swinging Neck Breaker
Text: As a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Piledriver, put it in your hand, then shuffle your Arsenal. As a reversal, may only reverse the maneuver titled Back Body Drop. End your opponent's turn.

name: T-Bone Tazzplex
Text: Cannot be reversed. When successfully played, you may draw 1 card.

name: Table! Table! Table!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card in your Ringside pile and your next Grapple maneuver played this turn is +8D and +1 Stun Value, and your opponent's Reversals to it are +4D. When successfully played by the Dudley Boyz, you may put 1 Grapple maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Tazz
Text: Once during your turn, discard 1 card and search your Arsenal for a card with the word 'suplex' in the title and put that card in your hand, shuffle your Arsenal. All maneuvers you play with the word 'suplex' in the title are -4F. Plus, Tazz's suplex cards can not be reversed by an opponent's suplex card!

name: Tazzmission
Text: As a maneuver, if your next card played this turn is the card titled Maintain Hold, you can ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: That's Gonna Cost You!
Text: Can only reverse a Strike or High Risk maneuver that does 8D or greater. End your opponent's turn. # = total D of maneuver being reversed. Damage is applied to the opponent who's maneuver is being reversed. Read as 0 when in your Ring area.

name: The 9th Wonder of the World
Text: Draw 1 card. Your opponent must return up to 3 maneuvers, of your choice, in his Ring area to his hand. If the card titled The 9th Wonder of the World is in play at the start of your turn, you may return it to your hand during your draw segment.

name: The Federation's Purest Athlete
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver. End your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, all your maneuvers next turn are +2D.

name: Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle
Text: As an action, if your next card played this turn is a Strike maneuver, it is +6D, if it is a Grapple maneuver, your opponent's Reversal card to it is +12F. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards 1 card. At the beginning of your next turn, your first card played is considered to be played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. If it is a Strike maneuver, it is +6D, if it is a Grapple maneuver, your opponent's Reversal card to it is +12F.

name: Throw Opponent Out of the Ring
Text: Can only be played after a maneuver of 5D or greater or the card titled Irish Whip. Search your Arsenal for any non-unique maneuver, or for the card titled Roll Out of the Ring, put it in your hand; then shuffle your Arsenal. If your next card played this turn is Roll Out the Ring it can not be reversed.

name: Thug It - Dead
Text: Shuffle up to 10 cards with the word 'suplex' in the title from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, draw 3 cards, and end your turn.

name: Time Keeper's Bell
Text: The card titled Roll Out of the Ring must be played before playing this card. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card in your Ringside pile after a successfully played maneuver, your opponent must discard 4 cards and take the top 4 cards from his Arsenal and put them into his Ringside pile.

name: Tori Enters the Fray!
Logos: Kane, Road Dogg, X-Pac, Billy Gunn
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, Submission or High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn. If played from your hand, take 3 cards from your Ringside pile and shuffle them into your Arsenal.

name: Tornado DDT
Text: Can only reverse a maneuver played after the card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, unless that card is titled Monkey Flip. End your opponent's turn. If the first card played on your turn is a High Risk maneuver, you may disregard the 'Can only be played after...'text.

name: Trash Can
Text: When the card titled Trash Can is in the Ring, once per turn, any player on their turn may discard a card to 'use'the Trash Can. For each 'use'Trash Can may be reversed as usual. If reversed, put it into owner's Ringside pile. In the event there is more than one Trash Can in the Ring, declare the one you are using; each can be used only once per turn.

name: Triple H's Reverse Neck Breaker
Text: As a maneuver, you may draw 1 card. As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Turn the Tide
Text: Can only be played if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Your next maneuver played this turn can be played as if you have your opponent's Fortitude Rating and it cannot be reversed.

name: Turnbuckle Smash
Text: The card titled Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle must be played before playing this card. Add +1D for every card titled: Punch, Head Butt, or Turnbuckle Smash in your Ring area. Opponent must discard 1 card.

name: Who Booked This Match?
Text: Playable only if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. You may either draw 2 cards or force your opponent to discard 2 cards.

name: X-Factor
Text: Reverse any High Risk maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: X-Pac
Text: During your draw segment, you must draw 2 additional cards to your hand, then discard 1 card.
